en.headline: West Kowloon court imposes three-month hospital order on woman convicted of displaying seditious materials
en.dek: The 62-year-old was found guilty of knowingly displaying publications with seditious intent after materials including a colonial-era flag were found outside her Tin Shui Wai flat.
body: West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Friday convicted a 62-year-old woman of knowingly displaying publications with seditious intent and ordered her to undergo three months of compulsory treatment at Siu Lam Psychiatric Centre.

The court heard that between March and November 2024 the defendant displayed materials outside her flat in Tin Chung Court, Tin Shui Wai, including a colonial-era Hong Kong flag and printed items bearing slogans.
Psychiatric reports indicated she suffers from schizophrenia and delusional disorder but was fit to plead. She had pleaded not guilty.

The magistrate said the combined content of the materials clearly showed an intent to encourage others to pursue demands and revolution until the existing system was overturned. The charge falls under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance.

zh.headline: 西九龍法庭裁定六旬婦展示煲動刊物罪成 判三個月住院令
zh.dek: 62歲女子被指在天水圍天頌苑單位外張貼港英期旗幟及標語，被裁定明知而展示具煲動意圖的刊物罪成。
body: 西九龍裁判法院周五裁定一名62歲女子明知而展示具煲動意圖的刊物罪成，判處三個月住院令，須入小濱精神病治療中心接受強制治療。
案情指，被告在2024年3月至11月期間，在天水圍天頌苑單位外張貼包括港英期旗幟及印有標語的物品。
精神科報告顯示被告患有思覺失調及妄想症，但適合答辦。被告曾否認控罪。
裁判官指，涉案物品的疊加意思清楚顯示有意鼓勵他人堅持訴求及進行革命，直至推翻現有制度。控罪屬《維護國家安全條例》下的罪行。
